A higher evening charge also lowers it through this part, in an uneven way, from about 20% at 11.76 to about 1% at 22.57 US dollars, and daytime minutes count more with an evening charge of 17.12 US dollars or less (about 49% to under 1%, against about 34% to about 1% above it), in an uneven way.
Through it, a voice-mail plan raises the chance from about 4% to about 18%, while an international plan lowers it a little, to about 3%.
